w5-a-760e436e.zh: 我先发球！轮到你时，等影子变金色就点它～
w5-a-760e436e.en: I’ll serve! On your turn, tap the shadow when it turns gold!

w5-a-e5c9d3d8.en: Still high — let it come down!

w5-a-8be2fa97.zh: 呜呼——飞起来啦！插小旗的就是坡顶！
w5-a-8be2fa97.en: Woohoo — we flew! The pennants mark the crests!

w5-a-d6da08f3.zh: 全城 12 个坡顶都飞过啦！
w5-a-d6da08f3.en: All 12 crests in the city — hopped!

w5-a-4a04af8b.zh: 九曲花街的路牌建议每小时 5 英里——慢慢开，别碰到花坛！
w5-a-4a04af8b.en: Lombard’s sign says 5 mph — nice and slow, mind the flower beds!

w5-a-baa3f3d8.zh: 佛蒙特街只有 7 个弯，可坡更陡——慢一点！
w5-a-baa3f3d8.en: Vermont has seven bends but a steeper hill — slowly!

w5-a-4a24dc9b.zh: 九曲花街这一段有 8 个急弯，而且只能往下开哦！
w5-a-4a24dc9b.en: Eight hairpins on this block — and it’s one way, downhill!

w5-a-c3fe95c7.zh: 有人量过，佛蒙特街其实更弯：弯曲度 1.56 比 1.2！
w5-a-c3fe95c7.en: Someone measured it: Vermont Street is curvier — 1.56 to 1.2!

w5-a-7f1eaa1c.zh: 佛蒙特街只有 7 个弯，却被量出比九曲花街还弯！
w5-a-7f1eaa1c.en: Only seven bends, yet measured curvier than Lombard!

w5-a-774352f1.zh: 两条都开过啦！论弯，佛蒙特街赢；论花，九曲花街赢～
w5-a-774352f1.en: Both done! Vermont wins on bends, Lombard on flowers!

w5-a-f394a25d.zh: 点一下地面，扔到那儿！我去接～
w5-a-f394a25d.en: Tap the ground to throw — I’ll fetch!

w5-a-d4a250de.zh: 扔到那边就捡不回来啦，换个地方～
w5-a-d4a250de.en: Can’t fetch it from there — pick another spot!

w5-a-dac00abb.en: That was fun! Throw some more any time!

w5-a-60c324fe.zh: 金门大桥金圈！绕着两座桥塔飞～
w5-a-60c324fe.en: Golden Gate rings! Round both towers!

w5-a-471a2270.zh: 桥塔比海面高 227 米，1937 年就通车啦！
w5-a-471a2270.en: The towers stand 227 m over the water — open since 1937!

w5-a-bf57e7df.zh: 大桥这种橙色，名字叫“国际橙”！
w5-a-bf57e7df.en: That orange has a name: International Orange!

w5-a-80ad9d1b.zh: 骑上鹈鹕飞到大桥边，有金圈等你！
w5-a-80ad9d1b.en: Glide out to the bridge — there are rings!

w5-a-05f0c830.zh: 跟着我喊：嘿——咻！咻的时候推！
w5-a-05f0c830.en: Shout with me: heave — ho! Push on the "ho"!

w5-a-ebed5c01.zh: 叮当车终点的转盘是人力推的，车就这样掉头！
w5-a-ebed5c01.en: The cable-car turntables are pushed by hand — that’s how the cars turn!

w5-a-910cdcd4.zh: 三个转盘都推过啦！盖个章～
w5-a-910cdcd4.en: All three turntables pushed! A stamp for you!

w5-a-c44fdeb8.en: Let’s play hide and seek in a bit!

w5-a-5da58c2c.zh: 这里没地方藏～换个地方再玩吧！
w5-a-5da58c2c.en: Nowhere to hide here. Let’s try somewhere else!

w5-a-af138c00.zh: 我在这儿呢～下次再来找我！
w5-a-af138c00.en: Here I am! Find me next time!

w5-a-70995063.zh: 闭上眼睛数三下，我去藏好！
w5-a-70995063.en: Close your eyes and count to three!

w5-a-5aa34332.zh: 捉迷藏！你数到三，我去藏好～
w5-a-5aa34332.en: Hide and seek! You count to three, I’ll hide!

w5-a-3122a12b.zh: 想玩捉迷藏吗？点「问 BAYBAY」，再点「捉迷藏」！
w5-a-3122a12b.en: Fancy hide and seek? Tap Ask, then Hide & seek!

w5-a-06e95089.zh: 想玩捉迷藏吗？按 Q 问我，再选「捉迷藏」！
w5-a-06e95089.en: Fancy hide and seek? Press Q to ask me, then Hide & seek!

w5-a-5c7f6bf0.zh: 一只、两只……一起数数有几只海狮！
w5-a-5c7f6bf0.en: One, two… let’s count the sea lions!

w5-a-b5aa19f9.en: Every one of them — none missed!

w5-a-c9a06a9a.zh: 这些海狮 1990 年起就在 K 码头安家啦！
w5-a-c9a06a9a.en: These sea lions have lived on K-Dock since 1990!

w5-a-931ea3e1.zh: 最多的时候来过 2100 多只呢——2024 年 5、6 月！
w5-a-931ea3e1.en: The record: over 2,100 of them, in May–June 2024!

w5-a-420d6131.en: What a slide! This grass is slippery!

w5-a-c47f65e8.zh: 里昂街台阶大约 300 级，一路修剪整齐的树篱，正对着艺术宫！
w5-a-c47f65e8.en: The Lyon Street Steps: about 300 of them, neat hedges, and the Palace of Fine Arts dead ahead!

w5-a-6c4f2c8f.zh: 车要掉头啦！跟着我喊：嘿——咻！
w5-a-6c4f2c8f.en: The car’s turning! Shout with me: heave — ho!

w5-a-161fb877.zh: 前面坡顶插着小旗，开快点冲过去能飞起来！
w5-a-161fb877.en: Pennants on the crest ahead — go fast and we’ll fly!

w5-a-d811134b.zh: 看，K 码头上好多海狮！数数有几只？
w5-a-d811134b.en: Look at all the sea lions on K-Dock! Shall we count them?

w5-d-11b086d4.zh: 1989 年秋天起，海狮陆续搬到这片浮台上来了。
w5-d-11b086d4.en: From the autumn of 1989 the sea lions began moving onto these docks.

w5-a-1bac6ec4.zh: 放风筝咯！起风的时候按住放线，一松手它就往上爬！
w5-a-1bac6ec4.en: Kite time! Hold to let the line out in a gust, let go and it climbs!

w5-a-8def5145.zh: 放太久啦，它在往下栽！快松手！
w5-a-8def5145.en: Too much line — it’s diving! Let go!

w5-a-6cd4b449.zh: 哎呀，掉下来了！再放一次～
w5-a-6cd4b449.en: Oops, it came down! Up it goes again!

w5-a-64a470a4.en: All the line out — look how high!

w5-a-bae71f7a.zh: 码头绿地的海风最适合放风筝了！
w5-a-bae71f7a.en: The sea breeze on Marina Green is made for kites!

w5-a-e103a323.zh: 那是金门大桥！1937 年通车，桥塔高出水面 227 米。
w5-a-e103a323.en: That’s the Golden Gate Bridge! It opened in 1937; its towers rise 746 feet above the water.

w5-a-455782bb.zh: 那是苏特罗塔！1973 年建成的电视塔，高 298 米。
w5-a-455782bb.en: That’s Sutro Tower, the TV tower: 977 feet tall since 1973.

w5-a-fd00ff65.zh: 那是市政厅的圆顶！比美国国会大厦的圆顶还高 13 米。
w5-a-fd00ff65.en: That’s City Hall’s dome, 42 feet taller than the US Capitol’s!

w5-a-807355d3.zh: 那是科伊特塔！1933 年建成，塔里画满了壁画。
w5-a-807355d3.en: That’s Coit Tower! Built in 1933, with murals painted all around inside.

w5-a-bf1502d8.zh: 那是泛美金字塔！1972 年建成，当了四十多年全城最高楼。
w5-a-bf1502d8.en: That’s the Transamerica Pyramid! Built in 1972, the city’s tallest for over forty years.

w5-a-a4d4a432.zh: 那是 Salesforce 大楼，现在旧金山最高的楼，326 米！
w5-a-a4d4a432.en: That’s Salesforce Tower, the tallest in San Francisco: 1,070 feet!

w5-a-b399278c.zh: 那是渡轮大厦！1898 年建成，钟楼高 75 米。
w5-a-b399278c.en: That’s the Ferry Building! Built in 1898, with a 245-foot clock tower.

w5-a-6a54b10b.zh: 那是海湾大桥！1936 年通车，比金门大桥还早半年。
w5-a-6a54b10b.en: That’s the Bay Bridge! It opened in 1936, six months before the Golden Gate.

w5-a-39ce74bb.zh: 那是恶魔岛！岛上的灯塔是美国西海岸的第一座灯塔。
w5-a-39ce74bb.en: That’s Alcatraz! Its lighthouse was the first on the US West Coast.

w5-a-9d92be51.zh: 考考你！我指的那个是什么？
w5-a-9d92be51.en: Quiz time! What’s that I’m pointing at?

w5-a-cf12fea4.zh: 全答对了，你是旧金山通！
w5-a-cf12fea4.en: All correct: you know your San Francisco!

w5-a-6a011d8b.en: A few more landmarks you know now!

w5-a-3438493d.zh: 从这儿看不到大地标呢，去附近的观景点看看吧！
w5-a-3438493d.en: No big landmarks in sight from here. Let’s try a lookout nearby!

w7g-postcard-keep.zh: 万圣节明信片收进手帐啦，随时都能翻出来看！
w7g-postcard-keep.en: The Halloween postcard’s in our notebook — we can look at it any time!

w7g-costume-bat-wings.zh: 鹈鹕也扮成小蝙蝠啦，扑扇扑扇！
w7g-costume-bat-wings.en: Our pelican’s a little bat now — flap, flap!

w7-h-hunt-ahead.zh: 我看到南瓜灯的光了，就在前面！
w7-h-hunt-ahead.en: I can see a pumpkin glow — straight ahead!

w7-h-hunt-left.zh: 南瓜灯的光在左边！我们去看看～
w7-h-hunt-left.en: A pumpkin glow off to the left! Let’s go and see.

w7-h-hunt-right.zh: 南瓜灯的光在右边！我们去看看～
w7-h-hunt-right.en: A pumpkin glow off to the right! Let’s go and see.

w7-h-hunt-behind.zh: 咦，南瓜灯的光在我们后面！
w7-h-hunt-behind.en: Oh — the pumpkin glow is behind us!

w7-h-hunt-wisp.zh: 看到那团橙色的小鬼火了吗？南瓜灯就藏在它下面！
w7-h-hunt-wisp.en: See that little orange wisp? A lantern is hiding right under it!

w7-h-muertos-eve.zh: 剪纸旗和万寿菊都挂好啦。明天公园里通常会摆满祭坛，以官网为准。
w7-h-muertos-eve.en: The papel picado and marigolds are up. Tomorrow the park usually fills with altars — check the official site.

w7-h-procession-gather.zh: 大家戴着万寿菊花冠、捧着蜡烛在这里集合，通常七点出发，以官网为准。
w7-h-procession-gather.en: Marigold crowns and candles — everyone gathers here. It usually sets off at seven; check the official site.

w7-h-procession-walk.zh: 游行的队伍过来了。我们在路边安静地看，好吗？
w7-h-procession-walk.en: Here comes the procession. Let’s watch quietly from the side, okay?

w7-h-venue-pumpkins.zh: 今天这里有南瓜活动，摆了好多南瓜！时间以官网为准。
w7-h-venue-pumpkins.en: A pumpkin party here today — pumpkins everywhere! Check the official site for times.

realsf-calendar-alcatraz-sunrise-2026-10.zh: 今天是原住民日。恶魔岛上通常有一场日出聚会，大家安静地纪念。
realsf-calendar-alcatraz-sunrise-2026-10.en: It’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day. There is usually a sunrise gathering on Alcatraz — a quiet remembrance.

realsf-calendar-chinatown-halloween-fest.zh: 唐人街的万圣节庆典在 Waverly 巷，有手工、游戏和南瓜，去看看吧！
realsf-calendar-chinatown-halloween-fest.en: Chinatown’s Halloween Festival is on Waverly Place — crafts, games and pumpkins. Let’s go see!

realsf-calendar-dst-end-2026.zh: 今天凌晨两点，钟拨回了一小时，天会黑得早一点哦。
realsf-calendar-dst-end-2026.en: The clocks went back an hour at 2 this morning — it gets dark earlier now.

realsf-jets-blue.zh: 蓝天使飞行队通常下午三点左右上场，以官网为准哦。
realsf-jets-blue.en: The Blue Angels usually fly around 3 pm — check the official schedule.
